## Consistency

- [ ] Affected canonical documents are updated together.
- [ ] Traceability, risks, and acceptance criteria are updated where applicable.
- [ ] Informative inputs are not presented as authority.
- [ ] No unsupported implementation, test, deployment, or release claim is made.
- [ ] Links and Markdown structure have been reviewed.
- [ ] The complete diff has been reviewed before push.
